title: Maintenance
description: Every car's services, repairs and checks

help.title: About maintenance
help.overview: Each car's service book: services, repairs and checks, with their cost. The latest completed service with a next due date sets the car's next service.

sections.title: On this page
items: Plan a service as Scheduled. With a ready date, the car is blocked for bookings until then.
Complete it when the car is back: the block ends, and the damages it fixed become Repaired. Cancel frees the car and reopens the damages.
Chosen staff are notified 14 days or 1,000 km before the next service is due.
